title: STEADY YOUR STEPS
PRAYER FOR UNCERTAIN PATHS
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: narrow stone trail winding mountain pass

scenes.a: Your feet feel unsteady on this uncertain path.
When the ground beneath your next step feels unstable, turn to the Lord in Psalm 17, verse 5:
Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
scenes.sub: HOLD UP MY GOINGS IN THY PATHS

scenes.a: Heavenly Father, we admit our own understanding cannot keep us upright when the terrain grows steep.
scenes.sub: LEAN NOT ON YOUR OWN MIND

scenes.a: Establish our steps in Your wisdom today, and guard our hearts against every secret fear.
Sustain us through every heavy choice today, so that we do not falter or slide backward into doubt.
Amen. Lord, hold our steps steady when your feet feel unsteady on this uncertain path.
scenes.sub: SEEK THE LORD FOR EVERY STEP
